title: Parley — Open Response
description: Response body for POST /api/pact/parleys (§19.3.1). Added in PACT v2.1 (§19).

peer_invite_url.description: Capability URL embedding a ≥128-bit CSPRNG invite token — single-use per party slot, TTL ≤ the Parley TTL, REQUIRED on accept (§19.3.1). Travels out-of-band; grants accept plus one pre-accept state read, not join.

join_token.description: The opener's agent credential (§19.3.3): ≥128-bit CSPRNG, bound to this parley_id and the opening Mandate's agent_id, single-use for join, then presented on in-Parley operations.

facilitator.description: The recorded facilitator principal, or null (§19.3.1).

mandate_digest.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the §20.3 canonical body of the opening Mandate — the binding the server recorded when session_id was null at open.

expires_at.description: When the Parley times out (server clock): open time + ttl_seconds.

warnings.description: Non-fatal advisories (e.g. mandate expiry inside the TTL window, §19.5).
